description:
Create a store key (cd_iap_…) for your server: one store, only the scopes you list. The secret is returned ONCE — store it in the server's secrets, never in a client. Needs account credentials (a session or CHAINDADDY_API_KEY), never a store key.

Params: store_id, name, scopes (catalog:write|orders:read|orders:write|entitlements:read|entitlements:write|drops:write|rewards:award|events:read|messages:send), session_token?, idempotency_key?
Returns: {ok, idempotency_key, key: {id, name, prefix, scopes, createdAt, secret}}
Errors: NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED, HTTP_400

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for this write. Omit to generate one; reuse the returned idempotency_key to retry safely

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_create_store_key
title: Create a store key
